task_description: Upgrade the existing OWNER Master Control Panel into an enterprise-grade platform command center with live governance, platform intelligence, real-time monitoring, operational visibility, AI oversight, advanced analytics, and centralized platform orchestration. Includes new Prisma models, migration SQL, backend endpoints, 4 new frontend pages, upgrades to 3 existing pages, navigation updates, and command-center CSS.

All code verified through manual review of file structure, TypeScript patterns, import correctness, and component API compatibility. Review issues fixed: all 7 backend-frontend API contract mismatches resolved, groupBy DateTime aggregation replaced with app-level bucketing, newUsersThisMonth added, OwnerRealtimePage alert state implemented.
